notFound.title: Page not found

error.title: Something went wrong

venue.introBody: This map helps you find places and routes in {{name}}. This short tour shows you how.
venue.searchBody: Type a place name, room code, or service. Small typos are still found.
venue.chipsBody: Pick a category or a facility such as toilets to see every place of that kind. A–Z lists every place.
venue.floorsBody: Pick the floor you want to see. Floors with search results are marked.
venue.controlsBody: Zoom in or out, face north, or go back to the starting view.
venue.placeBody: Tap a place on the map or in the results to open its card. Directions to here shows step-by-step directions, and Share sends a link to someone else.
venue.languageBody: Switch between Indonesian and English at any time.
venue.infoBody: The map version is here, along with a button to replay this tour.

hero.title: Lost inside a building? Scan the code, then follow the map.
hero.description: PanduArah is an indoor map with step-by-step directions that opens right in the phone browser, including routes between floors by elevator, escalator, or stairs.
hero.imageAlt: Animated route from the lobby, up the elevator, to Radiology on the upper floor

steps.title: Three steps to your destination
steps.scanText: A QR code in the lobby, elevator, or parking area sets your starting point. You can also pick it manually.
steps.searchText: Type a room, shop, or facility name. Search forgives typos.
steps.followTitle: Follow the route step by step
steps.followText: Clear directions like "Go straight 20 m" and "Take the elevator to L1", shown on the map.

demos.title: Pick a demo building
demos.description: Seven fictional buildings with sample data. Everything runs on your device, with no login and no server.

missions.hospital: Find Radiology, then follow the route from Registration across floors.
missions.mall: Browse shops by category and route between floors by escalator.
missions.campus: Find classrooms and the library in two buildings joined by an outdoor area.
missions.office: Find a meeting room in a six-floor tower with a central elevator core.
missions.airport: Follow the route from the check-in counter to the departure gate.
missions.factory: See production lines, warehouses, fire extinguishers, and emergency exits in three buildings.
missions.concert: Find stands, the accessible area, and food booths in an oval stadium.

features.title: Why PanduArah
features.hardwareText: Printed QR codes are enough. No beacons to buy, install, or replace batteries in.
features.appText: The map opens in the browser and can be added to the home screen like an app.
features.offlineText: Maps, search, and routes are computed on the phone after the first visit.
features.accessibleText: Wheelchair mode avoids stairs and escalators, and temporary closures are routed around automatically.
features.languageText: Indonesian and English, including the direction texts.
features.shareText: Send a place or a route as a link, with no personal data.

edition.title: This is the landing page and demo edition
edition.description: This open-source repository contains the landing page and the visitor demo. The map editor, building manager console, and installation for your building are part of the full version of PanduArah.
